neet_phy_u18_t04_3.working: Isotones have equal neutron number. C-14 has 14 - 6 = 8 neutrons and O-16 has 16 - 8 = 8 neutrons.

neet_phy_u18_t04_4.working: With R ∝ A^(1/3), volume ∝ A and mass ∝ A, so density is independent of A. R is true and directly explains A.

neet_phy_u18_t04_5.working: Statement I is correct: R ∝ 8^(1/3) = 2 and density is constant. Statement II is incorrect: the nuclear force becomes strongly repulsive below about 0.8 fm.
